title: Tsuji vs. Newman: a new generation’s title war
summary: Callum Newman’s rapid rise challenges Yota Tsuji’s claim to lead New Japan. Their championship exchanges make two younger heavyweights central to the post-Tanahashi era.

chapters.title: Newman dethrones Tsuji
chapters.result: Newman defeats Tsuji for the IWGP Heavyweight championship.
chapters.context: The New Japan Cup winner converts his tournament momentum into the promotion’s leading title.

chapters.title: Tsuji wins the championship back
chapters.result: Tsuji defeats Newman to regain the IWGP title.
chapters.context: The return match reverses the spring result and restores Tsuji’s position at the top.
